pr_title: Compare uvc rtsp stream uri to host config
pr_body:
## Proposed change

The UVC RTSP camera stream currently picks the first rtsp stream given back from the API. However, this stream might not be accessible if unifi-video is running in a docker container for example. This change loops through the rtsp streams and finds one that has the same host as the nvr config entry.

## Type of change

- [x] Bugfix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

- [ ] New feature (which adds functionality to an existing integration)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix/feature causing existing functionality to break)
- [ ] Code quality improvements to existing code or addition of tests

  the configuration would look like.

```yaml

  - platform: uvc
    nvr: 10.0.0.206
    key: !secret uvc_key
    password: !secret uvc_camera_password
```

issue_context.title: Unifi Video Component shouldn't load only the first rtsp stream
issue_context.body:
## The problem

Right now the Unifi Video component loads the first RTSP stream given back via the API

https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/uvc/camera.py#L220

However, in my case (I run unifi video inside a host networked docker container) I get 3 different rtsp stream URLs inside unifi-video, the first 1 is a docker IP, the second is the host IP an the 3rd is another docker one. 

Short of moving that docker container out to a macvlan'd network and having to point all my cameras to another IP manually... for now I've copied the component to custom_components and changes [0] to [1] and everything works fine.

Should the component deal with failures and go get another stream from the list? Should we be able to put another parameter on the unifi component setup to say the host I want to get data from is really this particular host? I'm not sure.

EDIT - Actually... we already know the host from the config so maybe we should loop through the array looking for a url with the same host as what was given in the config. I'll see if I can add that in myself and do a PR 

## Environment

Docker running latest tag

arch | x86_64
-- | --
dev | false
docker | true
hassio | false
os_name | Linux
python_version | 3.7.6
timezone | Europe/London
version | 0.104.3
virtualenv | false

Config

```
camera:
  - platform: uvc
    nvr: 10.0.0.206
    key: !secret uvc_key
    password: !secret uvc_camera_password
```
